cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: I Know How to Win This
cards.instruction: Perform mastery of the rules, odds, and consequences while improvising every decision.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. I've calculated the optimal move in this raffle.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You buy a ticket. That's all.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. The timing of purchase is crucial.

mechanism: A assumes command of play and turns each rule correction into a supposedly planned test, improvising the next decision while claiming mastery of odds and consequences.
confusable: D186 learns vocabulary to belong; D210 performs tactical mastery of winning and rules, even as B exposes lack of knowledge.
comparison: Board-game token mistake becomes a claimed stability test; raffle randomness becomes a variable A pretends to have anticipated before purchase.
seedUse: Read both full cards and all four seeds. Preserve actual correction and false mastery, but make A govern real next choices rather than merely append a confident claim.
